items.title: AI usage generates a fragile codebase

extra.evidence: I can only speculate as to the reasons why I was laid off from Meta in May, but I suspect that one of the reasons is that I was a little bit more resistant to adopting AI/LLMs as coding tools than some of my peers. Don't get me wrong, I generated at least 90% of my code using AI in my last few months there, which was the minimum for a decent rating. But AI didn't 10X the amount of code I was writing. It didn't even 2X it. I was focused on code quality. I saw the code being pushed by some of my peers who were heavily reliant on AI, and I saw that it was brittle code. There were many subtle issues that would lead to tech debt in the long term, and even some glaring issues were ignored by very good programmers. items.title: Muse Ember: Our smallest, most efficient model

extra.evidence: Muse Ember is our smallest and most efficient model, designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day. Today, we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing. Muse Ember delivers more intelligence per dollar than Claude Haiku 5.5 or GPT-6 Luna at any reasoning setting: it matches Haiku's best score at about a third of the cost and beats every Luna setting. It also sits on the efficiency frontier of the full Artificial Analysis leaderboard: no model scores higher for less per task. items.title: opendatalab/MinerU mineru-4.2.0-released

extra.evidence: ## 4.2.0 MinerU 4.2.0 重点升级 WebUI 交互与结果溯源，改善复杂 PDF、公式和表格的解析质量，并完善设备选择、模型缓存、服务管理与输入安全。以下为相对 4.1.0 的累计更新，包含 4.1.x 期间已发布的改进。 ### WebUI 交互与结果溯源 - **新增原文与结果双向定位**：点击 PDF 或图片中的区域，即可定位并高亮对应的解析内容；点击结果中的段落、标题、公式或图表，也可返回原文位置。跨页合并内容支持切换来源页。 - **增强布局可视化**：合并后的段落、列表和表格可关联多个原文区域，并通过连线展示合并关系，方便检查阅读顺序、内容归属和跨页合并结果。 - **新增结果目录导航**：根据标题生成可折叠目录，支持快速跳转到对应内容。 - **重新设计上传区域**：集中呈现文件选择、拖放、粘贴、文件类型、上传进度和取消操作，让上传过程更清晰。 - **重做档位与页范围控件**：采用更紧凑的布局，优化选择与拖动体验，并展示解析服务的 CPU/GPU 运行状态。 - **加快 PDF 预览**：选择本地 PDF 后，浏览器直接预览完整文档，并行完成上传，减少预览等待和重复传输。 - **保持解析前后的预览状态**：解析完成后复用已加载的查看器，保留缩放状态，并以叠加标框展示布局结果。 - **减少重复处理**：复用已准备的输入文件、语义结果和素材，减少原文 PDF、布局 PDF 及预览文件的重复生成，加快结果预览与导出。 ### PDF、公式与表格解析 - **改进行内公式识别**：Standard/Advanced 在 PDF 原生文本路径中，使用 VLM 识别表外行内公式区域；识别结果为空或无效时，保留局部公式识别模型回退。 - **保护脚注公式并改进页边区域处理**：修复脚注公式被错误改标或过滤的问题，减少公式、编号与正文之间的归属错误。 - **改进嵌套与重叠区域处理**：优化重复区域筛选与合并范围，减少重复文本和过度合并；修正图内标注的归属，并改善合并图片的阅读顺序。 - **统一布局检测行为**：恢复 ONNX 与 Torch 后端的逐类输出阈值，提高不同后端处理结果的一致性。 - **改善原生文本恢复**：完善空 ToUnicode 映射下的字符恢复，并在后置 OCR 和失败恢复后清理残留的 Unicode 私用区字符，减少缺字和乱码。 - **保留仿斜体正文**：修复整行字符经过倾斜变换时，正常正文被误判并丢失的问题。 - **修复旋转页面中的表格方向判断**：结合页面旋转信息解释原生文字方向，减少表格被错误旋转的问题。 - **保持表格内图片与公式完整**：避免表格恢复过程中将图片、公式拆散，或错误分配到多个单元格。 - **改善跨页表格输出**：保留单元格拼接处的文本边界，完善空白续接、稀疏空白行和共享跨行单元格的处理。 ### 原生文档解析 - **利用 Tagged PDF 结构语义**：Flash 原生 PDF 文本解析可利用 Tagged PDF/PDF/UA 文档中的结构信息与阅读顺序；未覆盖或不可信的内容继续由几何规则处理。 - **改进段落续接**：结合缩进、句末位置等页面证据，改善大写字母开头的续接判断，以及跨页、跨栏段落合并。 - **改进原生表格恢复**：修复异常字形边界导致的行划分错误，以及部分数字表格中跨行单元格的归属问题。 - **改善字体粗细判断**：增强嵌入字体的字重解析，减少正常正文被误判为粗体的情况。 - **改善 Office 图片异常处理**：对部分超出图片…

items.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.summary: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry, reaction-condition optimization raises the yield of cobalt-catalyzed carbonylation from trace amounts to 84% and photocatalytic allylic amination from 13% to 69%. These results support metacognitive regulation as an approach to scientific ideation and its progression toward practical validation.

items.title: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
items.summary: Visual generative models increasingly blur the line between synthesizing observations and simulating environments. Yet visual plausibility alone does not constitute successful world modeling: compelling outputs may lack persistent state, physical dynamics, or causally consistent responses to interactions. We define a generative world model as a predictive dynamical system that maintains a persistent, history-conditioned representation of an environment, updates that representation in response to actions or interventions, and generates temporally coherent trajectories that reflect outcomes under observed and counterfactual interventions. From this definition, we derive an intelligence-oriented framework spanning perceptual grounding, persistent state modeling, controllable transformation, dynamics-aware prediction, and closed-loop interaction. We present WorldFoundry, open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation across video, 3D and 4D, embodied action, and interactive world systems. WorldFoundry unifies model and benchmark discovery, runtime and asset preparation, execution orchestration, artifact management, and interactive visualization, while modality-specific adapters preserve native inputs, execution semantics, output representations, and evaluation protocols. Explicit manifests, durable artifact contracts, and evidence-aware scorecards separate execution readiness from evaluative claims, making each claim traceable to its supporting artifacts. T…

items.title: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
items.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P^2-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P^2-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P^2-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.
